title: History Entry
description: One append-only entry in an object's lifecycle log, recording what happened, when, by whom, and against which version. See /docs/confidence-model.md and /ONTOLOGY.md ('Version').

by.description: Name/handle of the person responsible for this event.

version.description: The object's 'version' field at the time of this event.

note.description: Optional short explanation of what changed or why.
